name: Blog filter and post grid
purpose: Lets a reader browse every blog and news post, narrowing by category and sorting by date, and load more as they go.
description: Hairline-bordered block on the legacy "green" theme. Left 20%: sticky "Filter by category" checkbox list (2-column grid at 991 and below, wrapping row at 479). Right 80%: a header row "Showing N articles out of M" with a Sort by dropdown (newest / oldest), a 2-column grid (1 at 479) of post cards (image, serif title, date and read-time pills) and a "Load more" pill that reveals 20 more. Client-side filtering, OR across ticked categories.

evidenceNotes: Post dates/read times are computed in DEFAULT_POSTS (BlogFilter.jsx); the sample re-evaluates that exact expression. The page overrides the first 20 titles (FIRST_PAGE_TITLES).

The sort labels ("Date (newest first)" / "Date (oldest first)"), "Sort by", "Load more" and the empty-state line are hardcoded in the component (not props), so they are contract-owned and not modelled. On the only route it follows BlogFeatured (page order only).
Post image role is not certain from code (Placeholder "Post image"); allowed photo.brand and product.screenshot alongside neutral.
